note: Hand-written mock for the clickable prototype. NOT output of match-lab. Facts are placeholders for what match-reader will compute. DE/VI copy is a draft until the owner checks it.
coord_system: metres, origin bottom-left, x along the pitch toward the away goal

text.vi: Phạt góc! Bóng sẽ đi đâu?

plain.en: Short! Copperfield passed to a teammate nearby instead of crossing.
plain.de: Kurz! Copperfield spielte zu einem nahen Mitspieler, statt zu flanken.
plain.vi: Đá ngắn! Copperfield chuyền cho đồng đội đứng gần thay vì tạt bóng.

expert.en: Copperfield have played {corners_short} of their {corners_total} corners short today. The league average is about {league_short_share_pct}%.
expert.de: Copperfield hat heute {corners_short} von {corners_total} Ecken kurz gespielt. Der Ligaschnitt liegt bei etwa {league_short_share_pct} %.
expert.vi: Hôm nay Copperfield đã đá ngắn {corners_short}/{corners_total} quả phạt góc. Trung bình giải đấu khoảng {league_short_share_pct}%.

text.en: VAR is checking. What are they looking at?
text.de: Der VAR prüft. Was wird geprüft?
text.vi: VAR đang kiểm tra. Họ xem điều gì?

plain.en: Offside. The attacker was ahead of the last defender when the pass was played. The goal is ruled out.
plain.de: Abseits. Der Angreifer stand beim Pass vor dem letzten Verteidiger. Das Tor zählt nicht.
plain.vi: Việt vị. Lúc đường chuyền được thực hiện, tiền đạo đứng trước hậu vệ cuối cùng. Bàn thắng bị hủy.

expert.en: Offside by {var_margin_cm} cm, judged on the frame the pass was played.
expert.de: Abseits um {var_margin_cm} cm, bewertet im Bild des Passes.
expert.vi: Việt vị {var_margin_cm} cm, xét theo khung hình lúc chuyền bóng.

text.en: Copperfield bring on a forward. What's the plan?
text.de: Copperfield bringt einen Stürmer. Was ist der Plan?
text.vi: Copperfield đưa một tiền đạo vào sân. Kế hoạch là gì?

plain.en: Attack! A second forward joins, so Copperfield push more players up the pitch.
plain.de: Angreifen! Ein zweiter Stürmer kommt, also schiebt Copperfield mehr Spieler nach vorn.
plain.vi: Tấn công! Thêm một tiền đạo, nên Copperfield dồn nhiều cầu thủ lên cao hơn.

expert.en: Forwards on the pitch: {forwards_before} → {forwards_after}. The team's line moves up {line_shift_m} m on average.
expert.de: Stürmer auf dem Platz: {forwards_before} → {forwards_after}. Die Mannschaftslinie rückt im Schnitt {line_shift_m} m vor.
expert.vi: Số tiền đạo trên sân: {forwards_before} → {forwards_after}. Đội hình dâng cao trung bình {line_shift_m} m.

plain.en: Cross! Copperfield lifted the ball into the box for a teammate to head.
plain.de: Flanke! Copperfield hob den Ball in den Strafraum, damit ein Mitspieler köpft.
plain.vi: Tạt bóng! Copperfield đưa bóng vào vòng cấm cho đồng đội đánh đầu.

expert.en: Copperfield have crossed {fk_cross} of their {fk_total} free kicks near the box today.
expert.de: Copperfield hat heute {fk_cross} von {fk_total} Freistößen in Strafraumnähe geflankt.
expert.vi: Hôm nay Copperfield đã tạt bóng {fk_cross}/{fk_total} quả đá phạt gần vòng cấm.
